inputs.text: KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, accused the Congress government of corruption and deliberately failing to stop illegal mining, calling out Raghava Constructions owned by Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy as part of it, during events on Sunday, March 29 in Hyderabad. This is a clear example of how ruling institutions are designed to shield corporate interests connected to those in power, rather than any simple oversight. It's a structural feature that props up inequality, letting elites profit off resource exploitation while vulnerable workers and communities bear the brunt of the damage from this systemic greed. Real institutional reform is essential to prioritize labor rights and dismantle these entrenched patterns of historical injustice that continue harming the most marginalized.
